title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Summer Punch Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Summer Punch Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a tropical fruit medley with vibrant, sun-soaked flavour. A blend of ripe Pineapple, juicy Peach and bright citrus notes creates a multi-layered vape that bursts with sweet and tangy complexity. It’s a fruit-forward profile that’s bold, balanced and ideal for all-day vaping. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and designed for use with the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. The pods connect magnetically and work with the twist-activated dual pod system for quick and easy flavour switching. With two pods per pack, Summer Punch makes a bold standalone option or a lively partner to mint, ice, or other tropical flavours.
